current.text: Reports from Rockets media day say Durant will play fewer minutes this season. The Rockets claim they will cut his minutes significantly.

Experts disagree on how big the minutes cut will be. Lloyd does not believe the Rockets will cut him as much as they claim and expects about 36 minutes, maybe 35, because Ime Udoka plays his starters heavy minutes. Other experts expect the team to manage his workload more and say he may play a minute less.
If his minutes fall to about 33 a game, his value changes materially.
He is healthy now. The ankle injury he suffered in last season's playoffs has healed.
He is a projected starter next to Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Sengun. VanVleet's return adds a ball handler.
He should play almost only power forward and forward roles this season, with almost no time at shooting guard, because Houston has more guard depth.

In category leagues, experts see him as a late first round pick. Several mock drafters took him at picks 10 to 12 and would take him ahead of Tyrese Maxey, Jalen Johnson, Scottie Barnes and Steph Curry.

His Yahoo rank of 14 is about right or a slight value in category leagues, and getting him in round two is a value. His ESPN rank of 28 is too low, and he is Lloyd's best Rockets target at that price.
He has the narrowest outcome range of round two picks: best case 6th, worst case 24th, not counting injury.
In an auction mock he went for 40 USD. Josh would go only into the 30s and called 40 USD too rich.
Experts call him too early in points leagues around picks 11 to 19 and a bust at his Yahoo points rank.
With our March 28 end date, the Rockets play 3, 3 and 4 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21, only 10 games, a weak schedule. The Rockets have only 14 back-to-backs this season.
The Rockets are projected to win 54 games. They are expected to be conservative in the regular season and not chase seeding.

durable.text: He is an efficient scorer who shoots well from the field and the line on high volume. Points, FG% and FT% are his best categories.
He makes many turnovers, a weak category far below the league and his position. Steals are a minor weakness.
He is worth much more in category leagues than in points leagues.
Age is the main risk. At 37 and after very heavy minutes, experts worry about decline and whether his body holds up.

note: Experts see Durant as a late first round pick in 9-cat. Yahoo (value 42 USD, average cost 46.1) prices him close to that, ESPN (26 USD, rank 28) prices him low, and our league paid 44 USD last season, so expect about 40 to 46 USD in our room even though Josh found 40 USD too rich. His strong FG%, FT%, points and blocks for a forward, with turnovers as his only weak category, make him a clean fit for punt TO builds. In the first weeks, check whether he plays 35 to 36 minutes or nearer 33. Also plan around the Rockets' weak 10-game schedule in our playoff weeks.
